crew.original_title: カウボーイビバップ 天国の扉
crew.overview: The year is 2071. Following a terrorist bombing, a deadly virus is released on the populace of Mars and the government has issued the largest bounty in history, for the capture of whoever is behind it. The bounty hunter crew of the spaceship Bebop; Spike, Faye, Jet and Ed, take the case with hopes of cashing in the bounty. However, the mystery surrounding the man responsible, Vincent, goes deeper than they ever imagined, and they aren't the only ones hunting him.
crew.title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie

crew.original_title: 劇場版 ソードアート・オンライン -オーディナル・スケール-
crew.overview: In 2026, four years after the infamous Sword Art Online incident, a revolutionary new form of technology has emerged: the Augma, a device that utilizes an Augmented Reality system. Unlike the Virtual Reality of the NerveGear and the Amusphere, it is perfectly safe and allows players to use it while they are conscious, creating an instant hit on the market. The most popular application for the Augma is the game Ordinal Scale, which immerses players in a fantasy role-playing game with player rankings and rewards.  Following the new craze, Kirito's friends dive into the game, and despite his reservations about the system, Kirito eventually joins them. While at first it appears to be just fun and games, they soon find out that the game is not all that it seems...
crew.title: Sword Art Online: The Movie – Ordinal Scale

details.biography: Hiroyuki Kambe (神戸 洋行, Kambe Hiroyuki, July 22, 1967) is a Japanese anime director and animator. He made his debut as an animator in 1988. He also works under the name Shougo Hanaue (花上 将吾, Hanaue Shōgo).
details.name: Hiroyuki Kambe
